I was lucky to receive my FISP coupon this year, so I will take one bag of NPK and one bag of urea from the depot to put on my plot. I will plant the hybrid maize seed that came with the subsidy because my elder brother used it last season and his cobs were much bigger than mine. I also have two wheelbarrows of goat manure that I will spread before planting since this land belongs to me and I want to keep the soil good. I will not buy any chemicals for pests and I cannot irrigate here in Mwanza, so I am waiting for the November rains and my family will do all the work ourselves.
